title: The Website Specification
summary: The Website Specification is a project proposing to create a formal, RFC-style specification for website development, providing standardized documentation and rules for how websites should be built and documented.
problem_solved: Establishes a unified, formal specification standard for website development to improve consistency and documentation quality across the web.
why_valuable: Creates a common specification framework for websites similar to RFCs, enabling developers to reference formal standards rather than fragmented documentation.
